content.contents: life flows, it flows like a river, forever. it goes until it won't. water wanes when you start to decay, right? the river will dry. but right now, this river is going, it's flowing, it's nowhere near fading.
what makes me say this? could it be, things are going well?

i manifested at the beginning of this year, that this would be MY year. as we all do, every year, ironically or not. this year, it wasn't ironic, because i knew soon after we changed from 25 to 26, GUYAG would be released. and, hey, it did well! as did the charity album! as has my move! we're already nearly done with april. may is fast-approaching, and then june will roll over, and before we know it we'll be halfway through the year, and then we'll be done with the year, and another will come around. time is moving so, so fast, and part of that is coming from aging, but another part of it is coming from my schedule being jam-packed with shit to do.

since i've moved there's hardly been a day where i haven't been busy with friends, work, job applications... actually, on that note, the job applications thing isn't a necessity anymore, because yes, within 3 fucking weeks of moving i've managed to land a job at a sushi place!!!!

let me tell you, i have a history with sushi. back in university, when i was studying japanese on the regular, i found a local high-end sushi joint. great food and good atmosphere, that's what i discovered when i first ate there, and i made it my mission thereafter to try and get a job. after applying, i came in multiple times to check on my application, and eventually got called in for a trial shift. then i was interviewed, and indeed, i ended up working there for around 2 years.

there was a bunch of stupid drama when i left, easily avoidable issues overlooked by an arrogant manager (tale as old as time). i left, however, with a great deal of experience working in a high-end establishment, and an affinity for sushi. so, beginning work at this new place was something i knew could end up being a cakewalk, were i provided a trial shift.

similar to before, after sending off my application i waited a few days, went in and introduced myself, chased up the email a few days later and voila, trial shift. went well, then monday i get a call saying, we'd love to have you on the team. there ya go!

i feel like, y'know, things have really been aligning since i moved here. i've got a sound engineering gig over the weekend, then i start work next week, and it all means i can move out from living with my sister! which means i'll have independence again, which feels like it ebbs and flows for me.

i'm so happy. i'm really proud of myself. i've got so much work on my plate with commissions, part-time work, freelancing... feels like i'm starting to actually make a living. i guess we'll see where static goes from here, but i'm starting to feel less static and more dynamic. perhaps the next album should be titled as such, dynamic girl.. who knows LOL
oh yeah, speaking of the next album.... yes, work has begun! it did a little while back. work is slow, though, as i suppose you'd expect when i have so much exterior stuff going on.

thinking about it, it's worth noting i'm actually balancing work on two seperate albums right now. will either be of interest? hell if i know, but i'm hoping you'll all be pleasantly surprised... or something.
oh and, there's another little something coming out soon. not something new, but a new something from something else. stay tuned... :3
as always, much static love to you all.
